purpose: Freeze record for the MON-SI-001 pre-event reconstruction. Tests verify these hashes so the frozen state cannot change silently. Corrections are appended as dated errata only.

PRE_EVENT_ANALYSIS.md.method: sha256 of file content before the line '<!-- errata-pointer -->' (whole file if absent)

register.pre-event.json.method: sha256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators, UTF-8) of keys case_id, register, cutoff_utc, frozen, sources, claims

anchor.verification: tools/check_registers.py compares the frozen content with `git show <anchor>:<path>` and checks these hashes against the Git objects; the anchor SHA is also pinned in the checker. The manifest is a convenience record, not the source of truth.
